through_line: Open-source builders spent this week fixing the agent harness, not the model.
prior_through_lines: Agents are gaining persistent memory and self-composing skill loops between sessions.
On-device AI crossed an architectural threshold, not just a marketing one.
evidence_paragraph: Five of seven picks target the scaffolding around the model, not the model itself. Statewright (@azurewraith) moves state enforcement into Rust so the transformer cannot rationalize past a constraint. Semble (@TvDongen) replaces grep with a CPU-only hybrid index, cutting 98% of tokens before the model sees them. Code-review-graph (@tirth_8205) sends the agent only the files an edit touches — 49x reduction on a Next.js monorepo. Autoresearch (@karpathy) fixes the experiment loop, not the trainer, running 100 keep-or-revert cycles overnight. Oh-my-pi (@_can1357) replaces line-number addressing with content hashes, ending string-not-found loops.
counter_signal: Shen-backpressure (@reubbr, 2026-05-21) and agent-skills (@waldemarnt, 2026-05-19) point in a different direction — formal type-level invariants and supply-chain security — suggesting a parallel thread where the constraint moves into the specification language, not just the runtime.
